name: Shatterspear Pass
summary: Shatterspear Pass is a rugged, hidden mountain corridor tucked away along the eastern ridges of Darkshore. Long concealed and largely inaccessible to standard travelers, it serves as the secluded gateway leading into the isolated enclave of Shatterspear Vale.

sections.title: A Hidden Mountain Thoroughfare
sections.body: Tucked away high in the towering mountain range separating northern Darkshore from Mount Hyjal, Shatterspear Pass is an inhospitable, perilous path. In this quiet era, the passage remains heavily isolated and sealed off from the broader lands of Kalimdor, guarded by sheer cliffs and treacherous crags. Few travelers from Auberdine ever dare scramble along these jagged heights, leaving the path quiet, secretive, and veiled behind natural barriers.

sections.title: The Way to the Vale
sections.body: Beyond this steep, rugged approach lies Shatterspear Vale, home to an enigmatic settlement of jungle trolls known as the Shatterspear. Because the night elves keep a watchful eye across Darkshore, the pass functions as a vital threshold, maintaining the tribe's complete seclusion from the outside world. To reach the secluded vale, one must brave the jagged rocks and hidden ways where few outsiders are ever permitted to walk.

faq.answer: The pass cuts directly through the high mountains on the eastern edge of Darkshore, leading inward toward the remote, hidden settlement within Shatterspear Vale.

faq.q: Who controls Shatterspear Pass right now?
faq.answer: At present, the pass is essentially wild, sealed, and untouched. It sits quietly within the mountainous perimeter claimed by the Shatterspear tribe, well away from active night elf or Horde encampments.

faq.q: Can ordinary travelers simply walk through the pass?
aliases: can i walk to shatterspear vale
faq.answer: No. The passage is largely impassable and sealed off behind steep, unpaved terrain and perilous cliffs. Reaching it requires navigating extreme wilderness that keeps the valley beyond isolated from typical travelers.

faq.q: Are the night elves aware of the pass?
aliases: do night elves know about pass
faq.answer: The Sentinels patrol Darkshore diligently, but their focus remains on local coastal threats and corruption. The high mountain crags of the pass remain remote, neglected, and obscure to everyday patrols.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei defending Darkshore, the jagged eastern peaks represent a quiet boundary that keeps strange, isolated threats locked far away from their woodland sanctuaries.
To trolls who know Kalimdor's secrets, the hidden passage represents an enigmatic refuge where distant kin dwell far removed from the rest of the world.
